title: Fundamental Bounds and Efficient Estimation for Dead-Time-Constrained Event Detection, with Application to Single-Photon Lidar
summary: We develop an asymptotic statistical theory for parameter estimation from a class of non-i.i.d. periodic binary event-detection processes subject to nonparalyzable dead time and gating, which we call "dead-time event detection" (DED) processes. Such processes arise in single-photon lidar, fluorescence lifetime imaging, X-ray astronomy, and particle or radiation flux measurements in nuclear physics, where each detection renders the radiation/particle detector inactive for a recovery interval.
